hero.title: Security and compliance, built in from day one
hero.summary: True Aim is certified to ISO 27001 and SOC 2 Type 2 and aligns its controls with the GDPR, the Swiss FADP and DORA. Every claims decision is recorded with the facts, the rules and the reasoning behind it, so the record stands up to audit, regulatory review and dispute.

iso27001.title: ISO 27001
iso27001.body: The international standard for an information security management system. An accredited auditor checks that the controls exist, work and are reviewed.

soc2.title: SOC 2 Type 2
soc2.body: An independent audit of security controls over a period of months, not a single day. The report describes the controls and whether they operated as described.

dataProtection.title: GDPR and Swiss FADP
dataProtection.body: True Aim processes customer data as a processor under the EU General Data Protection Regulation and the Swiss Federal Act on Data Protection. The privacy policy sets out the roles, the data and your rights.

dora.title: DORA
dora.body: The EU Digital Operational Resilience Act sets requirements for financial entities and the technology providers they rely on. True Aim maps its controls against them.

humanInLoop.heading: A person stays in the loop
humanInLoop.p1: By default, True Aim prepares a recommendation for a person to confirm. Full automation runs only where you and your regulator allow it.
humanInLoop.p2: True Aim is mapped against DORA, the EU AI Act, FINMA and BaFin requirements, the NAIC in the United States and POPIA in South Africa.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.description: How True Aim collects, uses and protects personal data.

terms.title: Terms of service
terms.description: The terms that govern the use of the True Aim website and platform.

cookies.title: Cookie policy
cookies.description: Which cookies the website sets, who sets them and how to change your choice.

paia.title: PAIA manual
paia.description: Access to information under South Africa's Promotion of Access to Information Act.

aiTransparency.title: AI transparency
aiTransparency.description: How True Aim uses AI, what it decides and what it leaves to a person.

items.question: Which certifications does True Aim hold?
items.answer: True Aim is certified to ISO 27001 and SOC 2 Type 2. Its controls are aligned with the GDPR, the Swiss FADP and DORA. The audit reports are available to customers under a non-disclosure agreement.

items.question: Does True Aim decide claims without a person?
items.answer: Not by default. True Aim prepares a recommendation with the facts, the rules and the reasoning, and a person confirms it. Full automation runs only for the claim types where you and your regulator allow it.

items.question: Can a decision be checked after the fact?
items.answer: Yes. Every decision is recorded with its inputs, the rules that applied and the source document behind each figure, and any decision can be run again with the same result.

cta.heading: See the record behind a decision
cta.description: Bring your own invoices, claims or damage reports and the demo shows the finished outcome with its evidence.
